summary: Observations of 5 multicolored lights above the sea.
description: One evening in 1973, around 11 p.m., a child and his parents observed multicolored lights above Magenta Bay in Nouméa. These lights were stationary above the sea. Thinking it might be an airplane, the witnesses were very surprised to find the airfield completely closed when they passed by. An investigation the following day revealed no airplane or helicopter activity anywhere on the island. The witness mentioned other people who had made similar observations that night, but no further information has been gathered about this phenomenon, for which we lack details.

summary: Observation of a white object hovering above a field and rapidly rising into the sky: lack of information
description: In 2008, a witness reported an observation made between 1973 and 1976, without specifying the date or month. The date given here is arbitrary. The witness, walking alone along a country road, spotted a white object stationary a few meters above the ground in a hollow in the field. No engine noise was heard. Approaching the object, the witness saw flashes followed by intense lighting around it, which then took off noisily and rapidly gained altitude. The area where the object had been stationed was dark, black, but without any lights. This very strange, old case was only submitted to GEIPAN (the French UFO research group) in 2008, following a television broadcast. In March 2012, a GEIPAN expert spoke at length by telephone with the witness. Since the precise date of the sighting is unknown, and the witness refuses to name those around them who were aware of the sighting at the time, a serious investigation is impossible. One can also question the accuracy of the witness's memory regarding events dating back more than 35 years. Given these uncertainties, GEIPAN classifies this case as "C": investigation impossible. GEIPAN notes, however, that the sighting location is only 10 km from the Canjuers camp, the largest firing range in Western Europe, which at that time already housed numerous military vehicles of all kinds.
